text:
Anna: Heads-up — PR #4127 adds a JS heatmap example for Console dashboards but the embed JSON isn't aligning with trace keys in the heatmap preset. Seeing broken preview in Playground: https://ci.redwood/docs/preview/4127
Raj: Hmm, I saw that — playground throws `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'buckets' of undefined` when loading example
Anna: repro steps: open Console > Dashboards > Examples > Heatmap > click 'Open in Playground' -> preview fails
Maria: I can take a look at the PR — is it the trace key name mismatch we talked about earlier? @Kevin did we rename `trace_latency_ms` to `latency_ms` in the SDK export?
Kevin: Yep, we renamed it in 2025.05 to standardize. The docs example still uses `trace_latency_ms`.
Anna: OK that explains it. Short term fix: change example to `latency_ms`. Long term: add a shim during import or aliasing.
Raj: Patch idea: in the example JSON add a small mapping block: `traceKeyMap: { \"trace_latency_ms\": \"latency_ms\" }` — we can leave a comment
Maria: could we instead update the heatmap preset to accept both keys? Might be safer.
Anna: Let's avoid changing core presets in this PR. Smaller surface: update example + add note in migration guide.
Docs-bot: PR #4127 build preview succeeded: https://deploy.ci/redwood/4127/preview — tests: docs-lint ok
Emily: I'll open a tiny PR to tweak the JS snippet and update the markdown note.
Emily: Proposed code snippet:
```
// heatmap example snippet
const heatmapConfig = {
  metric: 'latency_ms',
  groupBy: ['route'],
  buckets: [0,50,100,200,500,1000]
}
```
Raj: LGTM. Add a one-liner in migration guide: 'rename trace_latency_ms -> latency_ms' and link to SDK changelog
Anna: Also add an owners line in the example file header to avoid future confusion: 'owners: docs, eng-platform'
Kelsey: small nit — can we also mention sampling bias note? sometimes heatmap buckets depend on span sampling
Anna: Good call. Emily can you add that note and ping me for a quick review? :thumbsup:
Emily: On it, will have PR in ~2 hours
Anna: thx. tagging @Kevin for FYI on the sample mapping idea
Kevin: FYI noted — happy to add an alias if this continues to be a frequent mismatch
Anna: closing loop: target merge before Friday cut.
